items.heading: A Three
items.text: A three-year BSc, on its own, is an entry ticket, not a finished career. The doors above entry level need either a master's degree, a four-year degree with high marks, or a specific skill that companies pay for.

items.heading: Two Bsc Graduates Rarely Face
items.text: Two BSc graduates rarely face the same list. A physics-maths-chemistry graduate and a botany-zoology-chemistry graduate are standing in front of different step. Here is how the subject groups differ.

items.heading: Every Exit Below Has
items.text: Every exit below has a written eligibility rule. Read the rule against your marksheet before you spend on coaching, because a wrong subject is the cheapest mistake to avoid.

rows: IIT JAM (MSc at IITs, plus IISc, NITs and other institutes through result sharing)

Any bachelor's degree in the final year or completed. The paper-wise subject rules sit with each admitting institute's programme. Chemistry programmes usually ask for Chemistry across all three years, and Mathematics programmes usually ask for Mathematics for at least two years.

JAM 2027 is on 14 February 2027 with seven papers: Biotechnology, Chemistry, Economics, Geology, Mathematics, Mathematical Statistics and Physics. It offers about 3,000 seats at 23 IITs and 2,000+ more elsewhere. Applications opened on 11 September 2026 and were extended to 19 October 2026.
CUET PG (MSc and other PG seats at central and many state universities)
Any bachelor's degree, final-year students can apply, no age limit. Each university then sets its own subject rules.

The 2026 cycle had 4.11 lakh registrations, 157 subjects and 198 participating universities. NTA has announced the 2027 tests from 1 March 2027. The 2026 application window ran from 14 December 2025 to 14 January 2026.
A bachelor's degree of at least three years with Mathematics or Statistics as a subject, or a BE/BTech, with 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwD). Final-year students can apply.
NIMCET 2026 was on 6 June 2026 for about 1,300 seats at 11 NITs and 2 IIITs. A BSc with maths is the natural entry. The 2027 brochure was not out at the time of writing.
The official step 2027 table lets you appear in the third year of a three-year BSc or after completing it.

step 2027 registration closes on 5 October 2026 (12 October with a late fee) and the papers run from 6 to 21 February 2027. Appearing is not the same as being hired: engineering-post PSU advertisements and many M.Tech seats name BE/BTech, so read each notice before you plan around a step score.

items.heading: Pick One Target Role
items.text: Pick one target role and read ten live job postings for it. Note the tools and documents that repeat.

items.heading: Learn the Most Repeated Tool
items.text: Learn the most repeated tool through a strong YouTube series or a reputable online course, judged on syllabus and update date, and make one small piece of work with it.

items.heading: Send That Work
items.text: Send that work with a three-line message to three people in the field, and ask one specific question.

items.heading: Write Down What You Learned
items.text: Write down what you learned and choose to continue, adjust or drop the exit.
